interface_description_summary: Current Android-oriented AdviserApp inspected through source and production web preview: requirements modal, catalog recovery, comparison, detail AI, saves and settings.

smells_detected.name: Silent Errors
matched_symptoms: Invalid budget has no visible feedback inside the open form.
Detail save acknowledgement is absent from the active detail modal.
smells_detected.message: UX-01: background notices do not provide usable feedback at the point of action.
smells_detected.recipe_summary: Scope feedback to the active interaction.

recipe_steps.detail: Render budget validation beside the input inside the modal.
Expose invalid state and move accessibility focus appropriately.
Test invalid values and failed saves without requiring users to close the modal.

smells_detected.before_example: Submit 0; the modal remains open with no error.
smells_detected.after_example: The same modal identifies the invalid budget and preserves all other choices.

smells_detected.name: Contrast Blindness
matched_symptoms: Selection is conveyed only by fill color on requirements options.
Essential input and dark web focus cues are below 3:1.
smells_detected.message: UX-03/04: selected state is missing from option semantics; essential boundaries/focus are insufficiently distinguishable. Normal text contrast passes.
smells_detected.recipe_summary: Add semantic selection and separate accessible outline/focus roles.

recipe_steps.detail: Use checked/selected semantics and visible check indicators.
Use independently tested outline and focus roles, without treating decorative dividers as controls.
Measure role pair contrast, then inspect keyboard and TalkBack states in both themes.

smells_detected.before_example: Identical option labels; color alone identifies selection.
smells_detected.after_example: Checked state is announced and visible; essential field/focus cues achieve 3:1.

smells_detected.name: Dead-End States
matched_symptoms: A search with no matches is described as a requirements mismatch.
The empty state offers changing requirements rather than clearing the active search.
smells_detected.message: UX-05: recovery exists but is directed at the wrong cause; the user can manually clear the input, so this is not a complete dead end.
smells_detected.recipe_summary: Offer recovery specific to the empty-state cause.

recipe_steps.detail: Compute empty-search, source/filter-empty and no-eligible states separately.
Expose clear-search/clear-filter actions near the message.
Verify cleared search restores results without modifying requirements.

smells_detected.before_example: No search matches leads to Chỉnh nhu cầu.
smells_detected.after_example: No search matches leads to Xóa tìm kiếm with confirmed needs unchanged.

smells_suspected.name: Overloaded Screen
smells_suspected.reason: Dense repeated cards and stacked comparison suggest scanning cost. No buyer testing or observed abandonment establishes overload; do not use a fixed seven-item threshold as proof.

clean_areas: Navigation uses five readable destination labels; the item count alone is not a mystery-navigation defect.
Price age, unknown total cost and unverified suitability are explicit.
Core text contrast passes in the measured light and dark palettes.
api_note: UXUI_API_KEY was absent. Internal-knowledge review only; no paid API or complete live taxonomy audit was performed. See https://uxuiprinciples.com/en/checkout for optional enrichment. Remediation steps are authored from observed evidence; time estimates are null because no API estimates were retrieved.
